pages.title: Join the Band
pages.text: Two toadstool colors decorate a home music corner after a real performance with the band.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Buy a maraca and find a group already sitting down to play. Use the instrument beside an active native music gathering; an isolated air click is insufficient.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Approach a group that has sat down to play music and join their session. The village supports a social music activity.
